detail.longDescription:
Everyone here probably already knows this… but you don’t have to use Microsoft VS Code with all its embedded #AI and #AgenticAI bull shit. 

**VSCodium** is the exact same thing, but with no AI at all. Plus, it’s free and #opensource for Windows, Mac, and Linux. If you use `brew` it’s a one-line install. 

#IDE #coding #development
#developers
#software 

https://vscodium.com/
